name: aws-billing-mcp
description: Get a non-expert from zero to a Slack-delivered, plain-English, waste-flagged AWS bill breakdown, and cache it so you don't pay per Cost Explorer call.

aws_access_key_id.title: AWS access key ID
aws_access_key_id.description: Access key ID for an IAM principal with Cost Explorer read access. Resolved by the AWS SDK's default credential chain.

aws_secret_access_key.title: AWS secret access key
aws_secret_access_key.description: Secret access key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

aws_billing_base_url.title: AWS Billing Intelligence API base URL
aws_billing_base_url.description: Base URL for the AWS Billing Intelligence API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

aws_billing_slack_channel.title: Default Slack channel ID
aws_billing_slack_channel.description: Slack channel or DM ID that `report --post-slack --yes` posts to by default (the --slack-channel flag overrides it). Leave blank to pass the destination on every run.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region for the EC2, CloudWatch and S3 calls. Cost Explorer is always served from us-east-1 regardless of this value.

aws_session_token.title: AWS session token
aws_session_token.description: Session token, required only when the keys above are temporary STS or SSO credentials. Leave blank for long-lived IAM user keys.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Optional. Name of a profile in ~/.aws/config (SSO, assume-role or credential_process). Leave blank to use the access key fields or the default chain.

aws_billing_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
aws_billing_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

aws_billing_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
aws_billing_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API instead of the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

aws_billing_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
aws_billing_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on its own HTTP requests (report delivery). Leave blank to use the built-in User-Agent.

aws_billing_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
aws_billing_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
